page: Amazon Web Services m8ib.96xlarge is a dedicated general-purpose instance engineered on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture. It features an x86_64 Intel processor operating at a clock speed of 3.9 GHz. The system provides 192 physical cores and 384 vCPUs across two threads per core, backed by 1536.0 GB of system memory to maintain a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

For network connectivity and I/O communication, the instance features a high-capacity baseline network bandwidth of 400 Gbps. The hardware configuration contains no local storage devices, requiring persistent storage to be provisioned via remote network volumes. Additionally, the instance contains zero integrated graphics processors and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The combination of 384 dedicated execution threads and a standardized 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio supports heavy compute consolidation while maintaining predictable multi-tenant or multi-service density. The primary architectural tradeoff is the complete reliance on external block storage for data persistence, offset by the high-throughput 400 Gbps network interface. Amazon Web Services m8ib.96xlarge is engineered for large-scale distributed enterprise applications, in-memory processing engines, high-concurrency web serving clusters, and extensive container fleets.
description: Amazon Web Services m8ib.96xlarge is a general-purpose Nitro-based server designed for large-scale enterprise deployments. Powered by a 3.9 GHz x86_64 Intel processor, the instance provides 192 dedicated physical cores and 384 vCPUs utilizing two threads per core. System memory is scaled to 1536.0 GB, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance does not include integrated local disk storage or hardware GPU accelerators, necessitating network-attached storage architectures. Networking performance is supported by a 400 Gbps baseline bandwidth allocation, enabling high-throughput data transfer across distributed systems. The massive CPU capacity and substantial memory allocation suit consolidated compute operations without local disk overhead. Amazon Web Services m8ib.96xlarge is suited for heavy multi-threaded workloads, massive container clusters, memory-intensive backend services, high-concurrency web serving, and extensive distributed data processing frameworks.
